2609.15669.title: Benchmarking Intra-Patient 3D Deformable Multimodal Image Registration
2609.15669.paper_summary: Multimodal image registration is a key component of many clinical workflows, yet it remains challenging because corresponding anatomical structures often exhibit substantially different image intensities across modalities. In this work, we present a comprehensive benchmark of intra-patient 3D multimodal deformable registration methods across three datasets covering different anatomical regions and difficulty levels, including both synthetic deformation recovery and real clinical scenarios. We evaluate classical optimization-based approaches and modern learning-based methods, including recent deep learning and foundation models, using complementary metrics: Average Dice similarity coefficient (DSC), average 95th-percentile Hausdorff distance (HD95), and a modality-independent structural similarity measure based on the MIND self-similarity context (MIND-SSC). Results show high variability across datasets, with learning-based methods demonstrating superior performance on large synthetic benchmarks, while only limited improvements are observed in real pelvic registration. A key finding of this study is the consistent disagreement between geometric metrics (DSC, HD95) and image-based similarity metrics (MIND-SSC), highlighting that improved overlap does not necessarily imply better global multimodal correspondence. Furthermore, anatomy-guided approaches achieve the highest overlap scores but exhibit degraded performance outside of segmented regions, revealing a trade-off between label-driven alignment and global structural coherence. Overall, our results indicate that no current method achieves robust performance across anatomies and modalities. We demonstrate that intra-patient 3D multimodal registration requires multi-criteria evaluation, including deformation-based metrics, and remains an open problem.
2609.15669.paper_summary_zh: 多模態影像配準是許多臨床工作流程中的關鍵組成部分，然而，由於相應的解剖結構在不同模態下的影像強度往往顯著不同，因此仍然具有挑戰性。在這項工作中，我們呈現了一個全面的基準，涵蓋三個數據集的患者內部3D多模態可變形配準方法，這些數據集涉及不同的解剖區域和難度級別，包括合成變形恢復和真實臨床場景。我們評估了基於傳統優化的方法和現代基於學習的方法，包括最近的深度學習和基礎模型，使用互補的指標：平均Dice相似係數（DSC）、平均95百分位Hausdorff距離（HD95）以及基於MIND自相似上下文的模態獨立結構相似性度量（MIND-SSC）。結果顯示數據集之間的變異性很高，基於學習的方法在大型合成基準上表現優越，而在真實的骨盆配準中僅觀察到有限的改進。本研究的一個關鍵發現是幾何指標（DSC、HD95）和基於影像的相似性指標（MIND-SSC）之間存在一致的不一致性，突顯出改善的重疊不一定意味著更好的全局多模態對應。此外，基於解剖的方式達到了最高的重疊分數，但在分割區域以外的性能有所下降，揭示了標籤驅動對齊和全局結構一致性之間的權衡。總體而言，我們的結果表明目前沒有任何方法能在解剖學和模態上實現穩健的性能。我們證明患者內部3D多模態配準需要多準則評估，包括基於變形的指標，並且仍然是一個未解決的問題。
